name: propflow
description: PropFlow — multi-tenant real-estate CRM (auth-server + crm-api + shared)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @propflow/shared && npm run build -w @propflow/auth-server && npm run build -w @propflow/crm-api
scripts.migrate: npm run migrate -w @propflow/auth-server && npm run migrate -w @propflow/crm-api
scripts.seed: npm run seed -w @propflow/auth-server && npm run seed -w @propflow/crm-api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @propflow/shared && npm test -w @propflow/auth-server && npm test -w @propflow/crm-api
